title: The start-up error screen tells members to send their whole data file to their gym
what: When the app cannot start, 'Save my data file' shares the full phone data (workouts, body weight, notes, profile and mobile number). The line under it says to send the file to the gym, who passes it on to MettleUp. Elsewhere the app promises the gym never gets body weight, photos or notes.
expected: The help line sends the file straight to MettleUp support, and says the file holds private data.
how_often: every time a member follows the help line on that screen
fix_line: Point the line to MettleUp support directly and say the file is private

title: A workout delete that fails half-way leaves the workout without its records
what: Deleting a workout first removes its records, then the workout, as two separate steps. If the second step fails, the member is told the workout is still there, but its records are already gone and nothing rebuilds them.
expected: Both steps happen together or not at all, so a failed delete changes nothing.
how_often: rare: only when the database refuses the second step
fix_line: Run both deletes in one transaction
